atomicity: Result/knowledge/Action completion/dossier/validations/event/source pins/post-bundle/append head are one semantic commit.
bundle_type: Native PersistenceBundle preserving the actual start.initial, two original prospective prefix events and exactly one new admitted PREPARE event

cold_restore.oracles: Reconstruct full parent/result/ledger/post-state binding from durable bytes, not writer memory; compare exact primary identities.

determinism.R05: Membership preserved; duplicates rejected where identifiers are unique. Do not change ordered ValidationInstance.inputs under the ValidationResult input-identity set rule.
determinism.compare: Canonical start/post identities, full typed payload, event and semantic Computation; no object/hash ordering dependence.
determinism.permitted: Only codec.SET_FIELDS collections: Snapshot actions/statuses/knowledge/validation_instances, dossier checks/alternatives/required_facts, SuppliedResult knowledge, PersistenceBundle sources.

independent_reproductions.history_isolation: New distinct process/store/run provenance label for every reproduction; same sealed prospective lineage and semantic source identities; never append another A04 to the primary history.
independent_reproductions.identity_policy: Equal semantic inputs may have equal content-addressed event IDs in distinct stores. Run identity is separate; never relabel any reproduction as the original historical occurrence.
independent_reproductions.preparation: Load the exact two-event sealed start, not an already-completed A04 state.

replay: From exact sealed start prefix, reproduce the one historical dossier event, supplied result and recorded validation outcomes exactly once; no fresh validator decision and no A05/A06 execution.
required_bundle_identity: Actual planner-bundle-v1 canonical content identity; not computed until the supported full native event operand exists
writer_termination: Persist native head, terminate writer process, clear inherited objects; independent readers receive paths/IDs only.
